# 数据库操作指南

## DuckDB 连接管理

### 获取连接

```rust
use yu::duck_db::DBProvider;

// 使用默认配置
let db = DBProvider::default();

// 或指定连接池
let db = DBProvider::new(pool);

// 获取连接
let conn = db.acquire()?;  // 返回 PooledConnection<DuckdbConnectionManager>
```

### 连接池配置

```rust
// yu/src/duck_db.rs
pub fn get_connection_pool() -> &'static Pool<DuckdbConnectionManager> {
    CONNECTION_POOL.get_or_init(|| {
        Pool::builder()
            .max_size(15)                                          // 最大连接数
            .min_idle(Some(5))                                     // 最小空闲连接
            .connection_timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)) // 连接超时
            .build(get_duck_connection_manager())
            .unwrap()
    })
}
```

## 批量插入数据

### Appender（推荐方式）

```rust
use duckdb::params;

let conn = db.acquire()?;
let mut appender = conn.appender("bn_spot_trade")?;

for trade in trades {
    appender.append_row(params![
        trade.id,
        trade.event_time,
        &trade.symbol,
        trade.trade_id,
        trade.price,
        trade.qty,
        trade.trade_time,
        trade.is_buyer_maker,
        trade.created_at,
    ])?;
}

appender.flush();  // 确保所有数据写入
```

### PO 的 to_params 实现

```rust
use duckdb::appender_params_from_iter;

impl HistoryPO for SpotStreamTradeRecordPo {
    fn to_params(&self) -> duckdb::AppenderParamsFromIter<Vec<&dyn duckdb::ToSql>> {
        appender_params_from_iter(vec![
            &self.id as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.event_time as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.symbol as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.trade_id as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.price as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.qty as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.trade_time as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.is_buyer_maker as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
            &self.created_at as &dyn duckdb::ToSql,
        ])
    }
}
```

## 事务处理

### 显式事务

```rust
use duckdb::DropBehavior;

let conn = db.acquire()?;
let mut tx = conn.transaction()?;

// 配置事务提交行为
tx.set_drop_behavior(DropBehavior::Commit);

// 执行操作
let mut appender = tx.appender("bn_spot_trade")?;
appender.append_row(params![...])?;
appender.flush();

// 自动提交或回滚
drop(tx);
```

## 查询数据

### 准备语句

```rust
let conn = db.acquire()?;
let mut stmt = conn.prepare("
    SELECT symbol, MAX(event_time) as max_time
    FROM bn_spot_trade
    GROUP BY symbol
")?;

let results: Vec<(String, i64)> = stmt.query_map([], |row| {
    Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?))
})?
    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
```

### 参数化查询

```rust
let symbol = "BTCUSDT";
let mut stmt = conn.prepare(
    "SELECT price, qty FROM bn_spot_trade WHERE symbol = ? ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 10"
)?;

let trades = stmt.query_map([symbol], |row| {
    Ok((row.get::<_, f64>(0)?, row.get::<_, f64>(1)?))
})?
    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
```

## 表创建和初始化

### 初始化表

```rust
pub fn initial_tables(db: Option<DBProvider>) -> Result<(), YuError> {
    let db = db.unwrap_or_default();
    let conn = db.acquire()?;
    
    // 创建现货成交表
    conn.execute_batch(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bn_spot_trade (
            id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,
            event_time BIGINT,
            symbol VARCHAR,
            trade_id BIGINT,
            price DOUBLE,
            qty DOUBLE,
            trade_time BIGINT,
            is_buyer_maker BOOLEAN,
            created_at BIGINT
        )"
    )?;
    
    Ok(())
}
```

## RocksDB 操作（用于实时缓存）

### 滚动数据库

```rust
use li::rocksdb::rolling_kv_db::{RollingKVDB, RollingKVDBConfiguration, BatchData};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::collections::HashMap;

let config = RollingKVDBConfiguration::new_with_path(
    PathBuf::from("/data/rolling_db")
);
let mut db = RollingKVDB::new(config).await;

// 批量写入（每天自动轮转）
let mut batch = HashMap::new();
batch.insert(b"key1".to_vec(), b"value1".to_vec());
batch.insert(b"key2".to_vec(), b"value2".to_vec());
db.write_batch(batch)?;

// 读取单个值
if let Some(value) = db.read_value(&b"key1".to_vec()) {
    println!("Value: {:?}", value);
}

// 关闭时清理
db.close().await;
```

### 特点

- 每天自动创建新的 ColumnFamily
- 自动删除过期数据
- 支持多键值批量操作
- 内置性能统计

## 批量写入的性能优化

### SpotStreamStorageActor 缓冲策略

```rust
pub struct SpotStreamStorageActor {
    trade_buffer: Vec<SpotStreamTradeRecordPo>,  // 缓冲区
    received_count: u64,
    flushed_trades: u64,
}

impl SpotStreamStorageActor {
    fn get_trade_batch_size(&self) -> usize {
        100  // 攒够100条再写
    }
    
    fn get_flush_interval_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        5000  // 或每5秒自动刷新
    }
    
    fn flush_trades(&mut self) {
        if self.trade_buffer.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        
        match self.write_trades_to_db() {
            Ok(count) => {
                self.flushed_trades += count as u64;
                self.trade_buffer.clear();
            }
            Err(e) => {
                error!("Failed to flush: {:?}", e);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### 定期刷新

```rust
impl Actor for SpotStreamStorageActor {
    type Context = Context<Self>;
    
    fn started(&mut self, ctx: &mut Self::Context) {
        let interval = Duration::from_millis(self.get_flush_interval_ms());
        ctx.run_interval(interval, |act, _ctx| {
            act.flush_trades();  // 定期自动刷新
        });
    }
}
```

## 错误处理

### 连接池错误

```rust
use yu::errors::YuError;

let conn = db.acquire().map_err(|e| {
    error!("Failed to acquire connection: {}", e);
    YuError::CustomError("Database connection failed".to_string())
})?;
```

### 批量写入错误

```rust
match self.write_trades_to_db() {
    Ok(count) => {
        info!("Flushed {} records", count);
    }
    Err(e) => {
        error!("Write failed: {}", e);
        // 不清空缓冲区，下次重试
    }
}
```
